info.name: StoreForge API
info.description:
Every StoreForge API route, grouped by module.

Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner) to walk the full flow: sign up a fresh customer, sign in as customer and admin, browse the catalog, fill the cart, check out, pay, have an admin fulfil the order, review the product, then refund and cancel orders.

Test scripts save the IDs each step needs (tokens, productId, variantId, cartItemId, orderId, paymentId, reviewId, adminProductId) into collection variables.

Before you run it:
- Start the server (`npm run dev`) and set `baseUrl` if it isn't http://localhost:3000.
- Set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` to a seeded admin account.
- /auth/register and /auth/login are rate limited to 10 requests per 15 minutes per IP.
- The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie, so Refresh/Logout use whichever session signed in last (Postman's cookie jar).
